## Job title
Aerospace Engineer

## Job Summary
Our company is seeking a passionate and dynamic Aerospace Engineer responsible for designing, developing and aerodynamic testing of progressive air and spaceship parts, vehicles and systems. 

## Required Skills
- Aptitude for Operation Monitoring
- Active Listening
- Exceptional Critical Thinking
- Efficiency in Time Management
- Expert in Complex Problem Solving
- Skilled in Repairing

## Required Experience
- A minimum of two years experience in Aerospace Engineering
- Four Years experience in being a Bus and Truck Mechanic as well as a Diesel Engine Specialist 
- Three years as a Food and Tobacco Roasting - Baking - and Drying Machine Operator and Tender

## Responsibilities
- Develop, design, and troubleshoot aerospace vehicles, system and components 
- Monitor equipment operations to ensure consistency and conformity with standard operating procedures
- Participation in crucial operational procedures, including inspections, maintenance and repair work
